entities.summary: Caspar Cornelis Johannes Veldkamp is a Dutch politician and former diplomat who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs in the Schoof cabinet between July 2024 and August 2025. A former ambassador to Israel (2011–2015) and Greece (2015–2019), he started his political career as a member of the House of Representatives for the New Social Contract (NSC) party in 2023.
